settings.subtitle: A premium ergonomic bar stool for island benches and multi-purpose tables - in 550 mm and 680 mm heights, with a plain or padded fabric seat.
The premium bar stool series
settings.heading: OUI
settings.alt: SIDIZ OUI bar stools at an island bench
settings.description: The OUI is a premium bar stool series, made to pair with island benches and multi-purpose tables for meals, reading and rest alike.

settings.title: Standard / 550 mm
settings.description: Plain seat, 550 mm legs - for 800-850 mm desks and mini island benches
settings.alt: The OUI standard seat at 550 mm

settings.title: Standard / 680 mm
settings.description: Plain seat, 680 mm legs - for 930-980 mm standard island benches
settings.alt: The OUI standard seat at 680 mm

settings.title: Fabric / 550 mm
settings.description: Padded fabric seat, 550 mm legs - for 800-850 mm desks and mini island benches
settings.alt: The OUI fabric seat at 550 mm

settings.title: Fabric / 680 mm
settings.description: Padded fabric seat, 680 mm legs - for 930-980 mm standard island benches
settings.alt: The OUI fabric seat at 680 mm

settings.title: 550 mm, sized for the home island bench
settings.description: Matched to the most common 800-900 mm island tables at home. A lowered centre of gravity maximises stability, and the seat height suits the table without pressing on knees or legs.
settings.alt: The 550 mm OUI at a home island bench

settings.title: 680 mm, sized for the standard bar table
settings.description: Made for the 930-980 mm bar tables of cafes, restaurants and shared offices - trend-ready spaces and easy moments of rest, without disturbing the interior mood.
settings.alt: The 680 mm OUI at a standard bar table

settings.heading: From extended islands to standard bars: the right height for the space
Stability finished in the details you cannot see
settings.description: The OUI engineers away the wobble tall chairs are known for, down to details the eye never catches - selected materials and precise finishing for a steady, comfortable seat in every moment of the day.
settings.alt: The OUI's construction details

settings.title: A beech frame that will not bow
settings.description: Dense, even-grained hardwood beech steadies the high centre of gravity a bar stool carries. The timber's density and natural spring resist warping and hold firm support through years of use.
settings.alt: The OUI's beech wood frame

settings.title: A padded seat option that ends the hard-stool ache
settings.description: A padding layer inside the seat absorbs the load flexibly, resolving the pressure-point ache of hard bar stools and holding its cushioning through long sittings.
settings.alt: The OUI's padded fabric seat

settings.title: Glides that move quietly and spare the floor
settings.description: Friction-minimising glides under the legs cut the noise of moving the stool and prevent floor damage.
settings.alt: The glides under the OUI's legs

settings.heading: A premium ergonomic bar stool for island benches and beyond
settings.description: The minimal OUI series is an interior bar chair for modern living - from the island bench of an open kitchen to the home bar and the study's multi-purpose desk, comfortable through meals, work and rest alike.
settings.alt: The OUI across living spaces

settings.title: A one-piece shell that spreads the pressure
settings.description: A single shell supports from lower back to pelvis in balance; its unbroken curve holds the body firmly, so posture stays true even at bar height.
settings.alt: The OUI's one-piece shell

settings.title: A waterfall seat that thinks of circulation
settings.description: The seat's front edge curves away in a waterfall form, easing inner-thigh pressure and helping blood flow, whether you sit deep or perch lightly.
settings.alt: The OUI's waterfall seat edge

settings.title: An integrated steel footrest
settings.description: A steel footrest bonded into the frame supports the legs steadily, spreading the load from knees and lower body so long sittings stay composed.
settings.alt: The OUI's integrated steel footrest

settings.heading: OUI | 5-year warranty
settings.body: So the journey with your OUI continues, SIDIZ provides a 5-year warranty to customers who complete product registration. Once your stool arrives, register it before you forget, for more comfortable years ahead.
settings.alt: SIDIZ 5-year warranty badge

settings.heading: OUI dimensions
settings.figures: Maximum load 115 kg. Product weight approximately 6 kg (550 mm) or 6.5 kg (550 mm fabric), 10 kg (680 mm) or 10.5 kg (680 mm fabric).
settings.caveats:
*Measurements may vary by plus or minus 20 mm and 1 kg depending on where and how they are taken; this is not a fault.
*Dimensions are measured with nobody seated.
*Seat height is measured at the centre of the seat.
